text:
mika: kicking off tags_backfill job btf-422 on prod-shard-7. deploybot lease requested. ETA ~15m. paging @samir @qa

deploybot: lease granted to pipeline-7 for job btf-422. lock_watch=enabled, max_lock_threshold=3s. will emit stall alerts. :gear:

samir: initial metrics look fine — p95 ~60ms. seeing tiny lock blips on indexes, nothing sustained yet.

infra-bot: observability rule active: if blocking_count > 1 for 30s -> mark pause_required and notify #eng-oncall.

qa: quick Q — are we gating consumers with a feature-flag for this run or full-traffic?

mika: full-traffic non-invasive attempt. if locks escalate we abort + pin. runbook path: https://internal/runbooks/backfills#btf-422

deploybot: stall detected at 00:09:40. blocking_sessions=3, longest_lock=12s. auto-pause threshold breached.

samir: `pg_locks` shows exclusive lock on user_tags index rebuild, plus several waiters on relation user_events. not good.

mika: Try graceful pause first: run `./backfillctl pause --job btf-422 --grace 30s` and signal workers.

deploybot: pause signal sent to workers. waiting for acknowledgement. will escalate to force-abort if no response in 45s.

qa: grabbing traces + `pg_stat_activity` snapshot, uploading to release-notes draft: https://notes/internal/release/rt-2026-04

samir: workers unresponsive after pause window. proceeding to force abort per runbook.

deploybot: force-abort executed. job btf-422 status=FORCE_ABORTED. lease released. Applying deployment pin: platform pinned to v2.15.0 until next manual unpin. Notifying #eng-oncall. :rotating_light:

infra-bot: Created incident INC-2026-0458 and attached telemetry bundle.

mika: Next actions: - reduce chunk_size -> 200 - add 500ms sleep between chunks - worker_concurrency -> 1. plan retry in maintenance window Sat 01:00-03:00 UTC. Add release note: "btf-422 aborted due to lock escalation; pinned v2.15.0; retry scheduled with reduced concurrency"

samir: propose also adding a short prefix-cache bypass for this run to avoid KV cache misses causing index churn. will detail in runbook.

qa: I'll update release notes with abort command + rollback checklist and a post-mortem checklist to run after retry.

mika: OK. will unpin only after successful retry + 24h monitoring. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
